subject: Re: Acme Corp POC — Access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC — Post-call recap and next steps

Hi Alex / Emily —

Great to meet earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC running next week: 

Summary of decision criteria (from call):
- Ingest 500k customer support messages and run Redwood embeddings + reranking to improve search relevance (target: +15% NDCG)
- Latency requirement: 95th percentile under 300ms for single-turn queries
- Cost target: under $0.15 per 1k tokens on average with batching/caching optimizations

POC scope and success criteria (draft attached): acme-poc-success-criteria.pdf
- Ingest pipeline + sample dataset (you provide S3 link or share via Drive)
- API access for evaluation team (API key + IP allowlist)
- Run evaluation harness against our sample prompts and your queries (we'll provide an eval plan)
- Timeline: 2 weeks active evaluation, with a review at end of week 2

Immediate asks / owners:
1) Access & creds: Emily — please confirm the primary test account for SSO and the email we should invite for API key access.
2) Data: Alex — share the sample S3 path or drop the dataset in the Drive folder we created.
3) Technical kickoff: Vivek (cc'd) — will coordinate any IP allowlist or network/setup details with your infra.

Neha from our onboarding team will send the SSO invite and the onboarding doc. Vivek will generate a scoped API key and provide IP allowlist guidance. I'll coordinate the eval plan and run the first quality checks once you're onboarded.

Proposed timeline:
- Mon 10 May: SSO invite + API key issued
- Tue 11 May: Data transfer + baseline run
- Tue 25 May: POC review (end of 2-week window)

If that looks good, confirm the test email for invites and we'll send the SSO link and API key on Monday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: acme-poc-success-criteria.pdf

- Test users: please send SSO invites to dev+ai-eval@acme.com (this is our evaluation sandbox group).

Hi all —

I created a scoped API key for the POC: scope=embeddings,models:read,models:infer; quota=100k tokens; expiry=2027-05-22.
Key delivery: I've encrypted the key and uploaded it to the Drive folder (file: acme-poc-api-key.txt.gpg). Emily/Alex — please confirm when you have access and I'll post the decryption password via a separate channel.

IP allowlist: add the following CIDR ranges to your firewall for the POC: 34.81.12.0/24, 34.81.13.0/24. If you need a static egress IP instead, let me know and I can provision a static NAT for the duration of the POC.

Support: I'll standby for any connectivity testing tomorrow. Marissa — I'll join the kickoff if you want me there for the technical handoff.
